lines.description: Hire of battery-operated scissor lift, 12 m, without operator — one (1) unit, daily rate QAR 300.00 per day
Mobilisation and demobilisation to and from Birkat Al Awamer — two (2) trips, lump sum (see note 3)

notes: Placed against your rental quotation QU-H-10692-26 dated 17-11-2026, for a hire period of THREE (3) DAYS from the date of delivery: three (3) days at QAR 300.00 per day, QAR 900.00, plus mobilisation and demobilisation of QAR 400.00 — net QAR 1,300.00. Please acknowledge this order in writing and confirm the delivery date.

YOUR OFF-HIRE NOTICE PERIOD CONTRADICTS ITSELF AND MUST BE SETTLED BEFORE DELIVERY. Page 1 of your quotation states "End of Hire: As per customer off-hire notification earlier to 24 hours", while general condition E requires off-hire requests by e-mail not less than SEVEN (7) DAYS before the intended off-hire date. The two cannot both apply to a three (3) day hire, and a seven-day notice on a three-day hire would mean paying for days on which the machine is not on site. WE ORDER ON THE BASIS OF TWENTY-FOUR (24) HOURS' NOTICE, given by e-mail to rental@rs-qatar.co, and on the basis that no hire charge runs beyond the off-hire date so notified. Please confirm that in writing with your acknowledgement. We note your general condition J and record that this order is placed on that understanding.

MOBILISATION AND DEMOBILISATION — PLEASE CONFIRM THE FIGURE IS THE TOTAL. Your quotation shows QAR 400.00 against "Mobilisation and Demobilisation (Birkat Al Awamer), 2 trips". We have taken QAR 400.00 to be the whole charge for both trips, in and out. If it is intended as a rate per trip, say so in writing before delivery; no charge beyond QAR 400.00 in total will be accepted for mobilisation and demobilisation.

CERTIFICATES ARE TO ARRIVE WITH THE MACHINE. Your terms 4 and 5 provide third-party certification and group insurance. The valid third-party test certificate for the unit and the insurance certificate are to be handed over with the machine on delivery, as the site will not permit it to be operated without them. The machine is to arrive fully charged and in good working order, and a delivery report is to be signed by both parties on arrival and again on collection, as your general condition V requires.

OPERATION, ACCESS AND CHARGES. The unit is hired without an operator and will be operated only by our certified and licensed operators, in accordance with site safety requirements. We will arrange gate passes, inductions and permits for delivery and collection. Extra hours or days beyond the three (3) days ordered are chargeable pro rata at the daily rate stated and only where instructed by us in writing. No other charge — standby, idle time, cleaning, consumables or administration — will be accepted beyond the total order value above.

PLEASE RAISE YOUR INVOICE IN THE NAME SHOWN ABOVE. Your quotation is addressed to Doha Cooling Trading & Solutions W.L.L.; this hire is taken by The New Doha Kitchen Equipment Services W.L.L., C.R. 199351, and the invoice is to be raised in that name quoting LPO-221/2026. An invoice in any other name will be returned for correction. Our company documents for your approval accompany this order.

The unit is to be returned in the condition in which it is received, fair wear and tear excepted. We note your damage and insurance provisions, including the deductible of 10% of the loss subject to a minimum of QAR 2,500.00, and your charge for removal of branding.
